## Steering

- **NEVER** Never write a credential (AWS key, private key, GitHub/Anthropic/OpenAI/Slack token, hard-coded password) into a file; reference a declared secret instead. _(source: overwatch:gates/baseline)_ <!-- gate:secrets-in-writes -->
- **MUST** Every aws CLI call names the account explicitly with --profile (or AWS_PROFILE=...); never rely on the default profile. _(source: overwatch:gates/baseline)_ <!-- gate:aws-profile -->
- **MUST** Follow the hmode 9-phase SDLC, stored in protomcp. Read .project for the current phase; with no .project, ask whether this is a new project. Load the phase's rules before acting: store_get knowledge process:phase-<n>-<name> and process:phase-transitions, and search_standards 'critical rules' (core:critical-rules). No implementation code before Phase 8 unless the work is brownfield (after Phase 0) or a declared spike. <!-- hmode:sdlc -->
- **MUST** Before deciding how to do something in this repo, look in protomcp for guidance: search_standards (kind: gate for executable gates), search_tastes, search_knowledge and search_skills. Follow what it returns over your own defaults, and say which record you followed. <!-- overwatch:protomcp-first -->
- **SHOULD** Record what lasts in protomcp, namespace promptly-aws: learnings, decisions and gotchas with upsert_knowledge, and tasks with upsert_issue (the user's exact words in context.verbatim). <!-- overwatch:protomcp-record -->
- **SHOULD** Hooks create, update and close this session's record in protomcp (id cc-<session id>). Before you finish, add your work log to it with upsert_session on the same id: keep its name and description, put work done, decisions and follow-ups in context.log, and set issue_id or project_id when you know them. <!-- overwatch:session-log -->
